question: The area (in cm²) of an equilateral triangle whose altitude from vertex is 12 cm, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an **equilateral triangle**, the relationship between **Area** and **Altitude** (h) is given by:

Area = h² ÷ √3

⇒ Area = 12² ÷ √3 = 144 ÷ √3

⇒ Area = (144 × √3) ÷ 3 = 48√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 48√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Altitude** (h) of the **equilateral triangle** = 12 cm.

**Formula Used:**

1. Altitude (h) = (√3 ÷ 2) × side (a)

2. Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/080b917aa4292378340943d674fa8e0466e69f4f6130243f93e2032ca36c8c47.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 12 = (√3 ÷ 2) × a

⇒ a = 24 ÷ √3 = 8√3 cm

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × (8√3)²

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × (64 × 3)

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 192

⇒ Area = 48√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 48√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Equilateral Triangle

All three sides are equal, and each interior angle is 60°.

Inradius and Circumradius

Inradius (r) = a ÷ (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a ÷ √3.

Perimeter of Equilateral Triangle

Perimeter = 3 × side (a).</p
